_comment: Copy to appsettings.Production.json (loaded automatically when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production, the default; git-ignored) or use user-secrets (development) / environment variables (Tmdb__ApiKey, Admin__PasswordHash, ...). Never commit real keys. Anything not listed here keeps its value from appsettings.json.

Tmdb.ApiKey: paste a TMDB v3 API key OR a v4 read-access token (starts with eyJ)

Omdb.ApiKey: optional - official OMDb key, only used to fill IMDb ratings

Admin.PasswordHash: output of: dotnet run -- hash-password "your password"
